name: Music-led edits
description: Use when cutting a montage, travel video or music video: the song leads, cuts land on beats, energy follows the music, and the song starts and ends cleanly at the target length.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

Cut my clips to the beat
